summary: In 1937 they first got Social Security cards and played the Capital Theater with the ballroom dance team Tony DeMarco and Sally.

And by the way, that's when Social Security started, in 1937. We got our first Social Security cards at that date, you know. I'll never forget that. And from that, I'm trying to figure out what happened right after that. We came back to New York from there. That's when we went to the Capital Theater in New York at 50th Street and Broadway on the bill with Tony DiMarco and Sally.
Danced -- with him, he danced with her, they did ballroom dancing.
So ballroom dancing started to come in at this point, too. Or had it been in for a while?
It had been in -- but this guy was doing an act -- dancing, you know? But boy -- like a ballroom team. Which was lovely, they could dance nice.
